annotation.title_clean: Smart Africa Steering Committee convenes in Kigali, and endorses the establishment of the Africa Artificial Intelligence Council
annotation.title_en: Smart Africa Steering Committee convenes in Kigali, and endorses the establishment of the Africa Artificial Intelligence Council
annotation.summary_en: Press release on the 20th Smart Africa Steering Committee meeting in Kigali (2 April 2025), which endorsed in principle an Africa AI Council for continental coordination on AI infrastructure, data, skills, use cases and governance, plus bulk connectivity purchasing, cybersecurity coordination and a digital health network.
key_provisions_or_claims: Endorsed in principle creation of the Africa Artificial Intelligence Council covering compute, data, skills, use cases and governance/policy
Secretariat tasked to consult Member States and present an operationalization plan at the Transform Africa Summit 2025
Supported the Africa Bulk Purchase Market Place for school and health centre connectivity
Commended ANCA's five-year cybersecurity strategic plan
Approved soft launch of the Africa Digital Health Leadership Network
